name: Generic Interface Resolution
description: Overload resolution at semantics phase — each call resolves to a monomorphic procedure in FIR; name mangling scheme; no runtime dispatch
source:
subroutine demo_dispatch()
  integer :: i_result
  real    :: r_result
  real    :: v(3)
  v = [1.0, 2.0, 3.0]

  i_result = add(10, 20)
  r_result = add(1.5, 2.5)
  r_result = norm(v, 3)

  print *, i_result, r_result
end subroutine demo_dispatch

// *** IR Dump After FIR Lowering ***
// Generic interface resolution happened at semantics phase.
// FIR sees only monomorphic calls with mangled names.
module @_QMgeneric_math {

  // Module-level procedures (defined elsewhere in module)
  func.func private @_QMgeneric_mathPadd_int(%arg0: !fir.ref<i32>, %arg1: !fir.ref<i32>) -> i32
  func.func private @_QMgeneric_mathPadd_real(%arg0: !fir.ref<f32>, %arg1: !fir.ref<f32>) -> f32
  func.func private @_QMgeneric_mathPnorm_1d(%arg0: !fir.ref<!fir.array<?xf32>>, %arg1: !fir.ref<i32>) -> f32

  func.func @_QMgeneric_mathPdemo_dispatch() {
    %i_result = fir.alloca i32
    %r_result = fir.alloca f32
    %v_alloc  = fir.alloca !fir.array<3xf32>

    // v = [1.0, 2.0, 3.0] — array constructor
    %c1f = arith.constant 1.0 : f32
    %c2f = arith.constant 2.0 : f32
    %c3f = arith.constant 3.0 : f32
    %v0  = fir.coordinate_of %v_alloc, 1 : (!fir.ref<!fir.array<3xf32>>, index) -> !fir.ref<f32>
    %v1  = fir.coordinate_of %v_alloc, 2 : (!fir.ref<!fir.array<3xf32>>, index) -> !fir.ref<f32>
    %v2  = fir.coordinate_of %v_alloc, 3 : (!fir.ref<!fir.array<3xf32>>, index) -> !fir.ref<f32>
    fir.store %c1f to %v0 : !fir.ref<f32>
    fir.store %c2f to %v1 : !fir.ref<f32>
    fir.store %c3f to %v2 : !fir.ref<f32>

    // i_result = add(10, 20) → add_int (monomorphic)
    %t10 = fir.alloca i32 ; fir.store 10 to %t10
    %t20 = fir.alloca i32 ; fir.store 20 to %t20
    %ir  = fir.call @_QMgeneric_mathPadd_int(%t10, %t20) : (!fir.ref<i32>, !fir.ref<i32>) -> i32
    fir.store %ir to %i_result : !fir.ref<i32>

    // r_result = add(1.5, 2.5) → add_real (monomorphic)
    %t15 = fir.alloca f32 ; fir.store 1.5 to %t15
    %t25 = fir.alloca f32 ; fir.store 2.5 to %t25
    %rr  = fir.call @_QMgeneric_mathPadd_real(%t15, %t25) : (!fir.ref<f32>, !fir.ref<f32>) -> f32
    fir.store %rr to %r_result : !fir.ref<f32>

    // r_result = norm(v, 3) → norm_1d (monomorphic)
    %t3  = fir.alloca i32 ; fir.store 3 to %t3
    %shape= fir.shape 3 : (index) -> !fir.shape<1>
    %nr  = fir.call @_QMgeneric_mathPnorm_1d(%v_alloc, %t3) : (!fir.ref<!fir.array<?xf32>>, !fir.ref<i32>) -> f32
    fir.store %nr to %r_result : !fir.ref<f32>

    return
  }
}

; Flang name mangling scheme:
;   _Q = Flang prefix
;   M = module  → generic_math
;   P = procedure → add_int / add_real / norm_1d

declare i32  @_QMgeneric_mathPadd_int(ptr, ptr)
declare float @_QMgeneric_mathPadd_real(ptr, ptr)
declare float @_QMgeneric_mathPnorm_1d(ptr, ptr)

define void @_QMgeneric_mathPdemo_dispatch() #0 !dbg !5 {
entry:

  %i_result = alloca i32, align 4
  %r_result = alloca float, align 4
  %v_arr    = alloca [3 x float], align 4

  ; v = [1.0, 2.0, 3.0]
  store float 1.000000e+00, ptr %v_arr, align 4
  %v1_ptr = getelementptr inbounds float, ptr %v_arr, i64 1
  store float 2.000000e+00, ptr %v1_ptr, align 4
  %v2_ptr = getelementptr inbounds float, ptr %v_arr, i64 2
  store float 3.000000e+00, ptr %v2_ptr, align 4

  ; i_result = add(10, 20) — resolved to add_int at semantics phase
  %t10 = alloca i32, align 4
  %t20 = alloca i32, align 4
  store i32 10, ptr %t10, align 4
  store i32 20, ptr %t20, align 4
  %ir  = call i32 @_QMgeneric_mathPadd_int(ptr %t10, ptr %t20), !dbg !11
  store i32 %ir, ptr %i_result, align 4, !dbg !11

  ; r_result = add(1.5, 2.5) — resolved to add_real
  %t15 = alloca float, align 4
  %t25 = alloca float, align 4
  store float 1.500000e+00, ptr %t15, align 4
  store float 2.500000e+00, ptr %t25, align 4
  %rr  = call float @_QMgeneric_mathPadd_real(ptr %t15, ptr %t25), !dbg !12
  store float %rr, ptr %r_result, align 4, !dbg !12

  ; r_result = norm(v, 3) — resolved to norm_1d
  %t3  = alloca i32, align 4
  store i32 3, ptr %t3, align 4
  %nr  = call float @_QMgeneric_mathPnorm_1d(ptr %v_arr, ptr %t3), !dbg !13
  store float %nr, ptr %r_result, align 4, !dbg !13

  ret void, !dbg !14

correlations.lowering_notes: Generic interface add(INTEGER, INTEGER) resolves to add_int during semantics phase via argument type matching. By the time FIR is emitted, all generic calls have been replaced with direct monomorphic calls to mangled symbol names. The Flang mangling scheme encodes the module path as _QM<module>P<procedure>. No vtable, no type tags — purely compile-time disambiguation.

norm(v, 3) where v has rank=1 selects norm_1d over norm_2d via rank disambiguation at semantics time. This demonstrates that Fortran's overload resolution considers argument rank (not just type), which the semantics phase resolves statically without any runtime overhead.
